fixture_description: A synthetic B2B SaaS brand that provides an internal communications platform for distributed teams. Invented for the ADR 0013 copy audit mechanism test. No real company, product, or claim.

approved.text: Helix Relay reduces average internal response time by 40%.

prohibited.source_ref: Fixture: synthetic prohibition (quantified guarantee, not contractual)

notes_amendment_2026_08_10: Extended after the first beta-client caption. Two gaps the original fixture did not cover: every prohibition here was a claim string, so directive-shaped exclusions were never exercised, and there were no puffery samples, so the false-positive rate on unfalsifiable marketing language was never measured.
